scope: games of 10+ minutes with a final score, skaters with 20+ of them; league-wide by position and ice time (minutes, min <= his average < max)

events.win: his team wins (overtime and shootout included)
events.m15: his team wins by 2 or more (-1.5)
events.p15: his team wins or loses by 1 (+1.5)
events.tt: his team's goals over the strike
